headline: Is Muniz a threat to Gonzalo’s starting spot?
body: Like many others, I brought in Gonzalo for his run of fixtures, only to be disappointed by his inability to hit a barn door. Is there a realistic chance Muniz gets the nod over him against Coventry? Not that Muniz is exactly a world-beater himself, but surely the manager’s patience can only last so long?   submitted by   /u/Christuph [link]   [comments]
